component.name: VeyAmux
component.summary: Low-latency capture-card viewer and video player with GPU enhancement

description.p: VeyAmux shows the picture from a capture card or plays a video file and enhances it on the GPU with very low latency: the capture frame is converted, enhanced and displayed entirely in Vulkan.

ul.li: Upscaling with Snapdragon GSR, AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA NIS or AMD FSR 3.1
Retro TV (CRT-Geom) and pixel-perfect scaling for retro consoles
Noise reduction, sharpening, FXAA and colour controls
HDR capture, tone-mapped to SDR or shown on an HDR display (experimental), and VRR pacing
Frame generation with AMD FSR 3.1, or Lossless Scaling through lsfg-vk (optional, requires Lossless Scaling)
Instant replay, recording, screenshots and live streaming to Twitch or YouTube with hardware encoding
OBS browser source, window and screen capture
Menu control with a game controller, without the game reacting to it
A built-in demo scene (Abyssal Garden, an underwater world rendered live in 1080p) to try everything without a capture card
